observations: Rectangular dining table with a grey and white marble-patterned top.
Six black chairs with diamond-quilted upholstery on the outer backs.
Table and chair legs are black with gold-colored ferrules (tips).
The image contains a watermark for 'EBBY CONFIDENCE FURNITURE' and 'POSTED ON JIJI'.
The setting appears to be a professional showroom or a highly staged environment.

claims.evidence: Visual inspection cannot distinguish between solid marble and marble-effect laminate or veneer from this distance.

risks.risk: The table top may be marble-effect laminate or MDF rather than solid stone.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the edge and the underside of the table top.

risks.risk: Hidden tears, stains, or wear on the chair upholstery.
risks.proof: Individual close-up photos of each chair seat and backrest.

risks.risk: Structural instability or wobbling in the table or chairs.
risks.proof: A video showing the table and chairs being firmly shaken.
risks.if_unproven: as requiring joint tightening or minor repair

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the table top edge and underside to verify material.
Photos of the actual item in its current storage or home location to confirm it matches the showroom photo.
Clear photos of all six chairs to inspect for upholstery damage.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a 6-seater dining set. It is priced as a marble-effect/laminate set until the seller provides proof of solid marble construction.
